programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.desc: When Aunt Eleanora asks Ming-Ming to watch little Marvin, Ming-Ming brings the whole team to KalamaZoo! When Bee and Slug decide to explore what life is like underground, they get stuck in some ooey gooey mud.
programme.sub-title: Back to Kalamazoo!/Bee and Slug Underground!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: Ming-Ming flies through the shrink machine the wrong way and becomes enormous! In this swinging Andrews Sisters-style show, the Wonder Pets get a phone call from Little Bo Peep, who's lost her three singing Sheep.
programme.sub-title: The Bigger the Better!/Help Little Bo Peep!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: The Wonder Pets travel to Cape Cod to help a Lobster in a lobster trap free himself before the trap is raised. Floppy the Elephant comes to the classroom for a sleepover. But when Floppy gets homesick, the team must help him feel at home.
programme.sub-title: Save the Rock Lobster!/Help the Houseguest!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: The Wonder Pets travel to the Florida Everglades to reunite a pair of quarreling Lovebugs on Valentine's Day./The Wonder Pets get a call from Manchester, England where a Skunk Rocker can't find a band to play with him.
programme.sub-title: Save the Lovebugs!/Save the Skunk Rocker!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Ni Hao, Halloween: Trick or treat, it's Halloween! Kai-lan and her friends dress up to go trick or treating with Ye-Ye. Kai-lan is a dinosaur, Tolee's a panda, Hoho's the Monkey King, and Rintoo is his favorite – a dragon!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Beach Day: Kai-lan is excited because today she's going to the beach with Ye-Ye and her friends, to play in the sand, fly kites, and go in the water!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Roller Rintoo: Kai-lan and her friends are off to a roller rink to go skating! But when Rintoo won't put on his roller skates, Kai-lan thinks something is wrong. It turns out that Rintoo is scared of roller skating.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Rain or Shine: Kai-lan and her friends are planning a big day of playing outdoors, when suddenly it starts to rain! Kai-lan happily finds a way to play in the rain, but Rintoo, Tolee and Hoho are very upset because of the rain.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Ni Hao Kai-lan: Kai-lan and her friends wake up early today because...there's a CARNIVAL in the backyard with game booths, prizes and rides!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Lulu Day: Today, Kai-lan is having a playdate with her best girl friend, Lu-lu the rhino! Kai-lan is ready with all sorts of games and things to play with Lu-lu. But Lu-lu wants to play with DIFFERENT things than Kai-lan.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Sports Day: Kai-lan LOVES dinosaurs, and today she's made up a whole bunch of Olympic-style Dinosaur Games to play with her friends!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan gets a phone call from her favorite great aunt , Gu-nai-nai, in China, inviting us to come to China and meet a baby panda! Ye-Ye, Kai-lan, and her friends take an airplane to China to meet the baby.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan and her friends are hiking through the woods to the big Ladybug Festival! Tolee gets frustrated when the others don't listen to what he has to say. Kai-lan needs your help to figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan, Rintoo and Stompy are making a special dinosaur-shaped balloon for Lulu's hot air balloon festival!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Everyone's going over to Tolee's boat house to play, and Kai-lan invites us, too! All the friends have a great time... until Rintoo accidentally rips Tolee's new panda painting.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Hoho is thrilled because he's finally old enough to stay awake for the Chinese Moon Festival. He gets disappointed when he can't see the moon in the cloudy sky and Kai-lan needs your help to figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan and her friends are putting on a play based on the Chinese folktale about the Monkey King. When Rintoo gets the part that Hoho wanted, Hoho quits the play and it's up to the viewer to help Kai-lan figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Today, Kai-lan needs our help to plan a very special party for Ye-Ye to thank him for all he does for us. But when everything she plans goes wrong, Kai-lan gets very frustrated and starts to cry - much to the surprise of her friends!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan and her friends are riding a TRAIN all the way to Hula Duck Island! Everyone loves riding the train through the backyard, but when it gets to Stompy's house, there are no seats left for their elephant friend on the train.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan and her friends go to see the Chinese Rabbit Acrobats and are invited to be in the show! Rintoo is sure he'll be able to flip without practicing - no problem! Kai-lan needs your help to convince Rintoo to practice.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Today, Ye-Ye is taking Kai-lan and our friends to a super special, magical water park! Everyone's having a blast – until Rintoo starts splashing, cannonballing, and playing much too rough.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan sees the ants dancing in Ant City, and is inspired to help them put on a big dance show for everyone to see! But when they start to get ready, a bossy ant named BuBu makes all the choices about the dance routine.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Today, we're all invited over to Lulu's magical house in the clouds! Kai-lan is thrilled that Mr. Dragon is flying us there.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan invites us to come sail a beautiful dinosaur boat with her friends – and play hide and seek with some dolphins! But when Rintoo won't give Tolee a turn steering the boat, things come to a standstill.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan invites us to a dance party at the Hula Ducks' island beach house! But when the party games lead to Tolee having to sit out each time, he starts to cry.

programme.sub-title: La Ville au bord de l'Eternité

programme.title: South Park: L'Eté, Ca Craint
programme.desc: Alors que Jimbo et Ned veulent faire des feux d'artifice pour le 4 juillet, M. Garrison s'aperçoit que M. Toc a disparu et qu'il est 'son côté gay'.

programme.title: South Park: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé

programme.sub-title: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé

programme.title: South Park: La Varicelle
programme.desc: Les parents de South Park décident de donner la varicelle à leurs enfants pour éviter qu'ils ne l'attrapent vieux.

programme.title: South Park: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras
programme.desc: La classe de Mr. Garrison est emmenée au planétarium de South Park, qui est un lieu des plus ennuyeux.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras

programme.title: South Park: La Garçonnière
programme.desc: Alors que Stan doit construire une garçonnière pour jouer à 'action ou vérité' avec Wendy, ses parents se séparent.

programme.title: South Park: Les Journées Vaches
programme.desc: C'est la fête de la vache à South Park. La programmation inclut rodéo et fête foraine.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef a été spolié: on lui a volé des droits sur ses chansons.

programme.title: South Park: Poisson Sanglant
programme.desc: Tante Flo, la sœur de Sharon Marsh, offre à son neveu un poisson rouge. Mais Stan découvre que c'est en réalité un serial killer.

programme.title: South Park: Joyeux Noël Charlie Manson
programme.desc: Kyle, Kenny et Cartman s'en vont pour les fêtes de Noël dans le Nebraska pour aller rendre visite à la grand-mère de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Gnomes
programme.desc: Mr. Tweek risque de perdre son café à cause de la concurrence des cafés Harbucks.

programme.title: South Park: Tropicale, Schtropicale
programme.desc: Les garçons sont envoyés dans la forêt tropicale du Costa Rica avec les enfants de la chorale.

programme.title: South Park: Combustion Spontanée
programme.desc: Les citoyens de South Park prennent feu sans explication. Trouvera-t-on la cause de ces combustions spontanées?

programme.title: South Park: La Maman de Chef
programme.desc: Depuis que Chef a rencontré la fille de ses rêves, les garçons se sentent delaissés.

programme.title: South Park: Tweek contre Craig
programme.desc: Les garçons forcent leurs réticents camarades de classe, Tweek et Craig à se battre.

programme.title: South Park: Les Jakovasaures
programme.desc: Cartman découvre un Jakovasaure femelle, puis un mâle.

programme.title: South Park: Le Panda du Harcèlement Sexuel
programme.desc: Un panda, venu dans la classe de Stan et de ses amis expliquer le principe du harcèlement sexuel et encourager sa dénonciation, déclenche une folie du procès à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Orgie de Chat
programme.desc: Mme Cartman va à la fête donnée chez M. Mackey et laisse son fils sous la garde de Shelly Marsh.

programme.title: South Park: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi
programme.desc: Après avoir laissé Shelley chez les Cartman, la famille Marsh se rend chez M. Mackey, et Stan est relégué à la cave avec d'autres enfants pas très fréquentables. Pendant ce temps, les papas de South Park expérimentent le jacuzzi.
programme.sub-title: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi

programme.title: South Park: Les Scouts juifs
programme.desc: Pendant que leurs parents sont à la fêtes, Kyle, Ike et Kenny sont à une fête religieuse juif. Ils se rendent compte rapidement que cette cérémonie sera propice à un complot.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpokomon
programme.desc: Les enfants sont pris dans la folie Chinpokomon qui est en fait une conspiration anti-americaine de nostalgiques de Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: South Park: Ethernopien dans l'Espace
programme.desc: Pascal la Dalle cherche où reloger son village pour qu'ils échappent aux missionnaires chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park: Korn et le Mystère Mystérieux
programme.desc: À l'approche d'Halloween, South Park est en effervescence, sauf le père Maxi qui considère cette fête comme une vénération de Satan.

programme.title: South Park: Les Comptines du Singe Batteur
programme.desc: Un concours d'orthographe a lieu à South Park. Deux enfants qui sont scolarisés à domicile remportent le trophée alors que Cartman avait une arme secrète : les comptines du singe batteur.

programme.title: South Park: Médaille de Connerie avec Palme
programme.desc: Une reconstitution de la bataille de la guerre de Sécession, opposant les Nordistes aux Sudistes, est organisée à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey
programme.desc: Mr Hankey nous présente ses meilleurs vœux sous forme de showcase musical où tout le monde participe.
programme.sub-title: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey

programme.title: South Park: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil
programme.desc: Le monde se prépare à passer à l'an 2000, à South Park, on s'attend à ce que Jésus fasse venir Dieu sur Terre pour le millénium.
programme.sub-title: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil

programme.title: South Park: Le Bruit Marron
programme.desc: Un énorme concert de flûtes à bec dirigé par Yoko Ono et réunissant les enfants de tous les États-Unis doit se dérouler dans l'Arkansas.

programme.title: South Park: Inqualifiable crime de haine
programme.desc: Les filles défient les garçons à la luge. Les garçons acceptent, certains de gagner grâce au cul de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: La Petite Fée des Dents
programme.desc: Cartman se réveille et découvre que la fée des dents lui a apporté 2 dollars pour sa dent de lait. Il décide alors de chercher plein de dents pour s'acheter une console.

programme.title: South Park: Quintuple contorsionniste
programme.desc: Le cirque vient d'arriver à South Park. Le numéro des Quintuplés contorsionnistes donne envie aux enfants de faire un numéro.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy's own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.
programme.sub-title: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law's Ultimate Stratagem!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora's true intention…
programme.sub-title: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Fujitora's stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!
programme.sub-title: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law's traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!
programme.sub-title: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law's attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he's accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon's mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law's life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!
programme.sub-title: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon's actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.
programme.sub-title: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Corazon's double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.
programme.sub-title: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon's hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island.
programme.sub-title: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon's Farewell Smile!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Doflamingo & his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law's whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape, even if that means sacrificing his own life. A chain of lucky coincidences allows the plan to be set into motion.
programme.sub-title: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man's Final Fight!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Violet runs down the status of the open battles raging in Dressrosa - the Straw Hats, the Tontattas, the executives of the Doflamingo Family - all of them clash around the island, but it's Law's revelation to Doflamingo that moves the action forward!
programme.sub-title: To Be Free! Law's Injection Shot Blasts!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy continues to battle Fake-mingo, but keeps accidentally battling Bellamy instead. Meanwhile the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface. And Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.
programme.sub-title: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bellamy escapes Doflamingo's control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Lao G and Don Chinjao duke it out as each brings their most devastating attacks to the battle. But a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chinjao distracted - are they distracted enough for Lao G to gain the upper hand?
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Love! The New Leader Sai vs. Baby 5!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law is at the whim of Doflamingo and Trebol, while Luffy still has to deal with Bellamy, who fights to keep his honor even after being released by Doflamingo! Meanwhile, Gladius is about to detonate the ground around Cavendish and Bartolomeo!
programme.sub-title: The Man's Pride! Bellamy's Last Charge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield - but while it appears to help Bartolomeo and the others at first, it sets its sights on Robin! Meanwhile, the deeply-wounded Ideo sees Dellinger's horrible true nature!
programme.sub-title: A Strong Wind and a Surge! Hakuba vs. Dellinger!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bartolomeo is in a neck-and-neck battle against Gladius to save Robin, and is faced with an impossible dilemma. With all his options leading to their defeat, can his cunning ploy save the day? Meanwhile, Robin is face to face with Cavendish.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Princess Mansherry's amazing power - to heal living beings completely - is in the hands of the Donquixote executive. If she is able to heal all the executives who've gone down in battle - the Straw Hats and their allies stand no chance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Señor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both of them are pushed to their limits, we learn Señor's tragic past! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry's rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!
programme.sub-title: The Manly Duel! Señor's Elegy of Love!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky and Señor Pink end their harrowing duel in a manly way - but victory knocks the wind out of even the winner's sails! Meanwhile, Diamante and Kyros struggle desperately on the Sunflower Field, each demonstrating their extreme prowess.
programme.sub-title: Stardust of Death! Diamante's Storm of Vicious Attacks!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kyros, unbowed by Diamante's vicious attacks, fights back with the anger and retribution of all of Dressrosa in order to fulfill his promise to protect Rebecca. If he is successful, only a few executives will remain.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Pica loses his temper and turns his full wrath against King Riku, whom he hopes to destroy, ending the revolution against Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Zoro, who has been distracted by Pica and drawn far from the battle, has to hatch a plan to save the king!
programme.sub-title: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others on the old King's Plateau in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica's near-unstoppable onslaught. Meanwhile, King Riku ponders what it means to be a good king.
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro finishes off Pica, and those below his crumbling body rush to find shelter. Meanwhile, the Tontattas finish up demolishing the SMILE Factory, and Luffy's hand is forced in his duel with Bellamy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law's lifeless body! Meanwhile, Doflamingo takes the next step to end the game he started, which will endanger everybody in Dressrosa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Birdcage draws tighter and tighter around Dressrosa, threatening to destroy all life on the island kingdom! Meanwhile, Doflamingo stands down Luffy for a final confrontation, but a surprising twist shocks everyone on the top of the Royal Palace!
programme.sub-title: A Blade of Tenacity! The Gamma Knife Counterattack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law's attack proves powerful - but Doflamingo's power has depths which he and Luffy haven't bargained for. When Doflamingo makes his counterattack, Luffy stares him down with an amazing power.
programme.sub-title: A Collision of Haki! Luffy vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Trebol's wrath is fully inflamed as Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo's game. But Law gathers enough energy to do more than just speak out.
programme.sub-title: Unassailable! The Stunning Secret of Trebol!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Cavendish has to make a difficult decision when the severely wounded Law begs him to be left behind. Meanwhile, seeing even his Second Gear or Third Gear attacks aren't working against Doflamingo, Luffy decides to use his ultimate technique!
programme.sub-title: Anger Erupts! I Will Take Everything upon Myself!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Doflamingo duke it out while the Birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa! Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country, while Luffy's Fourth Gear proves quite potent against Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Birdcage continues its merciless constriction, sending the residents of Dressrosa fleeing towards the center of the island, while King Riku calls out to his people: Survive long enough for Luffy to vanquish the last of the royal family.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fourth Gear gives Luffy the power he needs to head off Doflamingo at every strike! But the energy required to keep Fourth Gear going starts to take a toll on Luffy. Will he have enough left to finish the job?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bounce-man's power has drained Luffy, leaving him in need of a rest before he can reuse his Haki, but luckily the gladiators from the Colosseum have come around and are focusing on taking down Doflamingo! Sabo steps in at a crucial moment.
programme.sub-title: Flame Dragon King! Protect Luffy's Life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Luffy and so many of the Straw Hats' allies incapacitated, victory seems inevitable for Doflamingo - but the compassion of Mansherry may be enough to turn the tide and renew their hope - to stop the Birdcage!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts towards slowing down the Birdcage as it squeezes the life out of the country! Meanwhile, Viola seeks Doflamingo out herself, for a shocking confrontation!
programme.sub-title: As Long as We Breathe! Stop the Deadly Birdcage!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper was packing all of his favorite things for a sleepover at his Grandma's House. But just as he was about to go, a big wind came in and blew everything away! Will Swiper find a way to use his new super-Swiper-spin today?!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: When the train to the Big Horse Show breaks down, Dora, Boots, and Pinto the Pony need your help to get there with the ribbons, so Pinto can win his first blue prize ribbon!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are getting ready for a big beach picnic with their friends, but when Benny gets stranded on Coconut Island, he'll need rescuing from Dora, Boots, and YOU!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora gets to start the Big Gymnastics Show! But when Swiper swipes her special rainbow ribbon, Dora and Boots need your help on a gymnastics-filled adventure to get it back so they can begin the show! Fantastic gymnastics!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: One night, while taking care of Abuela's 3 kitties, Dora awakens to find that Lucky has chased a ball of string right into a storybook world! Help her find him on a magical moonlight adventure!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora has a big surprise for Perrito on Surprise Hill, but Swiper's trying to get there first to swipe it! Join Dora, Boots, and Perrito for an animal-filled adventure with help from lots of friends and their playful pets too!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Everyone's getting ready for the big Thanksgiving Day parade and dinner, but the Pirate Piggies accidentally float away on Dora's boat float.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's on her way to the doctors for her yearly check-up! Dora likes going to see Dr. Valdés because she gets to hear her heartbeat, see how much she's grown in one year, and get a new sticker at the end of the visit!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Little Map: Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures. And he's getting really good, so today he's ready for his very first treasure adventure!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures, and today he's ready for his first treasure adventure! We help Little Map draw pictures and play map games to find the treasure at Treasure Mountain!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots take Baby Bongo on a musical adventure as they race to the Big Music Show in time for Baby Bongo's first performance.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Isa have been learning how the Earth's natural energy can power things we use every day. So they've made a volcano for the Science Fair!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are at the beach when they find a little lost mermaid who needs to get back to her mommy at Mermaid Cove. Together the 3 set off on an underwater adventure!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots discover Pincel, a cute little paintbrush who's lost and really wants to get back to Painter Daniella at the Art Studio.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Today's Benny's Sing-Along Party where Dora and Benny are going to sing a very special song together! C'mon, let's all sing-along!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots take a rainbow butterfly, Mariposa, to the Butterfly Ball where everybody gets to have wings.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus Adventure: Join Dora and Diego on an adventure to see Boots and Baby Jaguar's Amazing Animal Circus, featuring Perrito, the kitties, Tico, Isa, Benny, and lots more animal friends!
programme.sub-title: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus Adventure

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and her cousin Diego are on their way to a big surprise. It's Boots and Baby Jaguar's Amazing Animal Circus!
programme.sub-title: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus Adventure

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots become book explorers and enter the worlds of Peter Pan, the Wizard of Oz, and Little Red Riding Hood so they can find missing objects for the library's Story Wall.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Super Soccer Showdown: Dora travels to Brazil to play in the Big Cup Soccer Tournament, and if her team can beat the Monsters, they'll win the big cup.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs: Dora and Diego travel back to prehistoric times and go on a dinosaur adventure to find Baby Jaguar and bring him home to his birthday party.
programme.sub-title: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora in Wonderland: While Dora's kitties run through a magic mirror, Dora becomes Dora in Wonderland! Join her and Boots on a double-length adventure through the magical, mixed-up world of Wonderland!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Royal Rescue: Dora and Boots and the noble horse, Rocinante, are off to Story Castle to rescue Don Quixote from the evil wizard, Malambruno.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part III: Dora Saves King Unicornio: Dora and Boots return to the Enchanted Forest to save it from Owl, who has taken over as king and set up new rules banning scarecrows, elves and fairies from the forest!
programme.sub-title: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part III: Dora Saves King Unicornio

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Big Birthday Adventure: Happy Birthday, Dora! In the final episode of the Magic Storybook Trilogy (and a nod to The Wizard of Oz) Dora and Boots need to get home for Dora's birthday party.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Crystal Kingdom: Dora and Boots travel into a storybook to help their new friend Allie save the Crystal Kingdom. And they need your help! A Greedy King has taken all of the crystals that make the kingdom colorful.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Mermaids: It's Clean-Up the Beach Day, as Dora and Boots are cleaning up garbage when they find a Singing Clam, who tells them the story of Mariana the Mermaid. Mariana lives in the Mermaid Kingdom at the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's World Adventure: All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day! But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Dance to the Rescue: Put on your dancing shoes, because Dora needs you to spin, shake wiggle, jump and clap with her as she tries to rescue Swiper the fox, who's been trapped inside a bottle by a mean dancing elf.
programme.sub-title: Dora's Dance to the Rescue - HOUR SPECIAL

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Shredder Strikes Back - Part 1: On a training run Leo is ambushed by a major Foot attack force, including Foot Tech Ninjas, their old enemy Hun, and a new threat: the Foot Elite!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Shredder Strikes Back - Part 2: When the Foot Ninja attack April's apartment in force, the Turtles fight against overwhelming odds to get the wounded Leo to safety.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Tales of Leo: The Turtles, Splinter, Casey and April just barely manage to escape from the explosion that destroys the antique store. They hit the road and hide out at Casey's grandmother's old farmhouse, but Leonardo is badly wounded.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Monster Hunter: Still recuperating up at Casey's grandmother's farm, the turtles are feeling the sting of boredom. Luckily, a scientist known as the "Monster Hunter" has come to the area searching for a legendary monster…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 1: The Turtles return to New York (as the title might suggest) with one goal in mind: to destroy the Shredder once and for all.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 2: The Turtles and Splinter continue to fight their way up through the Foot Headquarters skyscraper, facing down three misshapen Mutant Shredder Clones, a hallway of traps, and the Mystic Ninja.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 3: With Stockman showing up in the middle of the final battle between our heroes and the Shredder, everything is thrown into chaos … so much so that our heroes must join forces with the Shredder and Hun to defeat Stockman.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Lone Raph & Cub: With Splinter mysteriously vanished last episode, the Turtles are feeling frustrated, not knowing where to start looking for him. Impatient with strategizing, Raph heads off on his own, and runs into a solo adventure.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Search for Splinter Part 1: After the frustrated Turtles exhaust their search for Splinter, their suspicions turn to the Guardians, and the trail soon leads them to a non-descript building, the initials of its company name spelling out "TCRI."

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Search for Splinter Part 2: The Turtles successfully infiltrate the mysterious TCRI Building, where they manage to sneak into its inner sanctum, and locate the unconscious Splinter inside a stasis tank.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 1 The Fugitoid: Our four heroes find themselves beamed halfway across the universe to the planet D'Hoonnib and right into the middle of a police action! There, they befriend the Fugitoid, a.k.a. Professor Honeycutt.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 1 The Fugitoid

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 2 The Trouble with Triceratons: On the planet D'Hoonnib, the Turtles team up with the Fugitoid, a.k.a. Professor Honeycutt, who is being pursued by the rogue military forces of General Blanque.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 2 The Trouble with Triceratons

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 3 The Big House: The Turtles are captured by the Triceratons and thrown into a Tri prison, their lives to be used as a bargaining chip to convince the Fugitoid to build his Teleportal device.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 3 The Big House

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 4 The Arena: Welcome to the Tri-sports Arena filled to capacity with cheering Triceraton crowds thirsty to watch grueling combat. Our four heroes have been sentenced to become gladiators in ruthless competition.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 4 The Arena

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 5 Triceraton Wars: With Professor Honeycutt (the Fugitoid) safely in tow and the Prime Leader as a hostage, the turtles are faced with their biggest challenge yet!
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 5 Triceraton Wars

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 1: Back from their adventures in space, the Turtles find themselves in the headquarters of the same aliens who teleported them across the universe! The discovery of an old friend and new allies leads to a trip back through time.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 2: The turtles and Splinter have taken a little trip down the Utroms' memory lane via a high-tech virtual reality device experiencing first hand the Utroms' crash landing on Earth and their life in feudal Japan.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 3: The Turtles and Splinter escape the Utroms' high-tech virtual reality device, only to find the Shredder and all his forces waiting for them. All shell breaks loose in yet another final showdown between our heroes and the Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Reflections: Catching up on some much-needed rest, our heroes take a little trip to Casey's grandma's farmhouse as well as a little trip down memory lane. But, every memory is haunted by the same dark figure … the Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Ultimate Ninja: There's a bad dude in town, and he's looking to pick a fight with Leonardo. This Ultimate Ninja has come halfway across the inter-dimensional universe to fight the Shredder, defeat him and gain glory.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Modern Love - The Return of Nano: The Turtles are in big trouble from a microscopic enemy when the bizarre Nano-monster returns! When the self-replicating techno-nightmare springs his criminal "father" out of jail and goes on another rampage.
programme.sub-title: Modern Love - The Return of Nano

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: What a Croc!: The Turtles discover that they're not alone in the sewer. The green ooze which mutated them years ago also claimed another victim… Leather Head!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to the Underground: The Turtles return to the ancient underground city they discovered in "Notes From the Underground" -- only to find the city abandoned, its crystal moon power source missing, and its human population reverted to monsters.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 1: With the Shredder gone, underworld factions clash for power in a gang war that threatens to tear the city apart!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 2: The Turtles find themselves in the middle of an escalating gang war between the remains of the Foot, the Purple Dragons and the mob (with their new ally Baxter Stockman!) Can the Turtles survive the deadly onslaught?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 3: The turtles have their hands full fighting the mob, the Purple Dragons and what's left of the Foot. Now, they've joined forces with Karai, who used to be the Shredder's right hand "man." Can they trust her?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Junklantis: Now that they've got a ShellSub, the Hudson River becomes the Turtle's underwater wonderland… NOT! The junk in the riverbed is even more dangerous than the city above when the Turtles run into their old nemesis the GarbageMan!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Golden Puck: Casey Jones loves the new sport of Super Slam Hockey. It's the pure evolution of a great game into a perfect game. But, when the legendary Golden Puck is stolen from the Super Slam Hockey rink in Central Park, Casey's beyond indignant.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Rogue in the House - Part 1: The Shredder is back … rested up … recuperated and repaired, and he has a new plan for global domination. The only thing he wants to do first is exterminate the turtles. Call it a trial run of his new ideas.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Rogue in the House - Part 2: Embracing a plan at gaining power through a number of FootMechs under his control, the Shredder has sent a robotic Splinter to seek and destroy our turtles.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: April's Artifact: The Turtles stumble across an antique puzzle cube that belonged to April's father, who mysteriously disappeared a few years ago. Messing with the cube, the Turtles and April are transported to another dimension…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return of the Justice Force: Mikey's quest for a rare comic book leads the Turtles and Casey back to Northampton, where they stumble on a mystery madman's plot to kidnap all the remaining members of a retired super hero team known as the Justice Force.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Big Brawl - Part 1: As he does every three years, Splinter mysteriously goes off leaving his four boys at home. Where he's going, he won't say. Unbeknownst to Splinter, the four boys are curious and follow.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Big Brawl - Part 2: Finding themselves in an inter-dimensional tournament, our four teenage mutant ninja turtles discover a past about Splinter they never knew...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Big Brawl - Part 3: As the BattleNexus Tournament continues, Leonardo has been poisoned and lies unconscious fighting for his life. Splinter is wrongly imprisoned for an attempt on the Daimyo's life.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Big Brawl - Part 4: It's down and dirty time. Splinter is imprisoned. Leo is dying of poison. Don and Usagi are fighting for their lives and the life of the Daimyo against a horde of assassins.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Christmas Aliens: Christmas is supposed to be a time of giving, not taking! But when a dangerous gang of theives hijack a truck full of holiday toys on it's way to an orphanage, it's time for Michelanglo to start passing out some season's beatings!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Space Invaders - Part 1: The Triceratons have invaded looking for the Fugitoid. Unfortunately, no one on earth knows what the heck the big horn heads are talking about.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues partent à la recherche du deuxième fragment que les Outromes ont confié aux Dagones Celles-ci vivent dans un royaume sous-marin, dans l'océan cosmique de Varuna.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Alors que les tortues s'apprêtent à partir chercher le dernier morceau du générateur de trou noir, elles sont happées dans un univers parallèle, celui des tortues ninja du dessin animé de 1987.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les Tricératons ont suivi la trace du vaisseau Ulysse. Ils lancent un ultimatum à son équipage : soit ils leur remettent les fragments, soit ils se font anéantir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues captent un signal de détresse. C'est Mona, qui leur apprend que son commandant Sal a été capturé par Armaggon sur l'ordre de Dregg.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Direction l'autre bout du cosmos, vers une galaxie au nom à rallonge, ZZ-Trois-Pluriel-X-Bêta, et plus particulièrement la planète Magdomar qui abrite selon les Outromes le troisième et dernier fragment du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le compte à rebours est lancé avant la mise en route du générateur de trou noir par les Tricératons pour aspirer la planète Terre. Il reste peu de temps aux tortues pour empêcher ces derniers de réduire la planète à néant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Retour dans un New York tranquille. Cérémonie pour April, organisée par Splinter. Elle est désormais kunoïchi. Mais le soir même, une mystérieuse sorcière lui vole son tanto du dragon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leonardo a fait alliance en cachette avec Karaï et Shinigami pour démanteler une à une les opérations de Shredder. Ils commencent par une planque des Dragons Pourpres, puis s'attaquent à l'usine chimique, un lieu névralgique de l'organisation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Stockman crée de nouveaux mutants pour l'aider à cambrioler les banques afin de réunir de l'argent pour Shredder. Un ancien homme d'affaires devient Scaramouche, un mutant mi-araignée mi-mouche. Il crée également une fourmi géante.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Don Vizioso veut prendre le contrôle de la ville. Pour cela, il doit se débarrasser des mutants présents dans la ville de New York.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey, Leo et Raph se disputent au sujet de leur BD préférée. Pour Mikey, Bat-Boulon et Écrou Kid sont au-dessus du panier. Leo préfère l'Homme-araignée, Supérieur-Man, ou encore l'Invincible Bossu. Pour Raph, il n'y a pas photo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder absorbe du mutagène et devient Super Shredder. Il capture Karai pour attirer Splinter dans un piège et en finir avec son ennemi juré. Mais Splinter lit clair dans son jeu et le piège à son tour.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Tandis que Donnie et Mikey partent explorer le gouffre à la recherche de Splinter, Leo, April et Karai affrontent Super Shredder. Karaï trouve son point faible : son cœur protubérant. Mais le méchant s'échappe à temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: April a une conduite de plus en plus étrange. Elle est possédée par un ancien Eon, Za-Noran, par l'intermédiaire de son cristal. Les tortues décident de détruire la pierre pour sauver leur amie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Quand Tokka décide de récupérer son petit, c'est le branle-bas de combat sur Terre. Les Forces de Protection Terriennes décident d'attaquer malgré les mises en garde de Bishop.
programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Tiger Claw et sa sœur Alopex ont été enlevés enfants par les Krangs. Le tigre et la renarde sont devenus ennemis. Alopex vole les lames de la vengeance dans un musée pour détruire son frère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Super Shredder teste un nouveau super mutagène concocté par Stockman-mouche, qui se révèle parfait pour sa prochaine mission : exterminer tous ses ennemis sans exception, et sans empathie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues rendent visite à Karaï à l'hôpital. Elle leur révèle où se trouve la planque de Super Shredder. Il s'agit d'une forteresse high-tech en pleine forêt, défendue par ses footbots et autres sergents.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues enquêtent sur une mystérieuse secte qui se réunit dans les égoûts. Tiger Claw a décidé de ressusciter Super Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Tiger Claw ordonne à Kavaxas de ramener Rahzar à la vie, ce qu'il parvient à faire. Il lui dit de reproduire ce prodige avec Shredder. Mais il lui manque un élément essentiel, le Kuro Kabuto.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Kavaxas a besoin du cœur de Shredder pour le ressusciter. C'est Don Vizioso qui s'en est emparé et qui le conserve dans une fiole. Les tortues et Tiger Claw vont tout faire pour le lui reprendre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder prend le pouvoir et détruit le sceau. Kavaxas est libre, il ouvre le portail du Royaume des Ténèbres et les revenants déferlent sur Terre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Maître Splinter réunit ses quatre fils, pas encore adolescents. Il leur raconte en détail la genèse de leur histoire, et leurs débuts dans les rues hostiles de New York.
programme.sub-title: Il était une fois Splinter et les tortues...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Panique le soir d'Halloween : New York est envahi de vrais zombies, vampires et loups-garous. April et Casey sont contaminés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues veulent tuer Dracula avant que Savanti ne s'en empare. Mais Raph est transformé en vampire et Savanti s'enfuit, emportant avec lui la momie, un loup-garou (le père d'Esméralda), Raph et Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja partent en Allemagne en 1818 pour tenter d'arrêter Savanti Roméro, qui veut engager Frankenstein dans son armée. Ils échouent mais grace à Reinette les tortues retournent dans le futur pour une dernière tentative.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: La ville de New York est envahie par des monstres en tous genres. Les tortues, aidées de Reinette, tentent de déjouer le plan de Savanti Romero et de Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Un vaisseau se dirige vers la Terre. Le lieutenant Iguissg'ba et le commandant Gazéwroka ont reçu l'ordre de prendre en chasse un mercenaire en cavale, K'Vathrak, qui n'est autre que le Tritonateur.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation heated when Dr. Phil gave self-professed bully Temica RoShawn a reality check about her aggressive behavior. Guests Ross & Lyndy say weeks of bullying culminated in their 15-yr-old son being sexually assaulted.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristen says two years ago she was manipulated into placing her newborn for adoption with her ex-stepfather Adam and his new wife, Stacy, who Kristen says promised she could remain in the child's life. Adam & Stacy insist they did everything by the book.
programme.sub-title: Adoption Nightmare: I Want My Baby Back

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gina asked Dr. Phil for help with her daughter Alexis, saying she was kidnapped by her survivalist boyfriend David. As the story unfolds, another layer surfaces, allegations of molestation by a family member. Find out who, and will a polygraph tell all?
programme.sub-title: My Ex-Wife Claims I Molested Our Daughter Who Ran Off With Her Boyfriend Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There have been no answers to the whereabouts of Summer Wells, 5, missing since 2021. Parents Don & Candus say it backfired by requesting the public's help. In this exclusive first national TV interview, Dr. Phil digs deeper into the story.
programme.sub-title: Summer Wells Disappearance: What Do The Parents Know? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: McKinley, 18, says she decided 5 years ago she never wanted to see her dad, Cory, again, after learning he went to jail on two counts of sexual battery of a minor! She says her dad is a violent, dangerous, "psychopath". Cory says he's never abused anyone.
programme.sub-title: Sex Abuse Allegations Ruined My Run For Congress And My Relationship With My Daughter Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This 2004 YouTube viral video sent shock waves, racked up millions of views, and stirred online outrage. Texas Judge William Adams is lashing his then 16-year-old daughter with a belt, despite her pleas to stop. Do you think Adam's actions are justified?
programme.sub-title: Discipline Video: A Daughter's New Accusations Against The Judge

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heroin use among America's youth is plaguing some of the most prestigious & safest suburban towns. Dr. Phil sheds light on Simi Valley, CA, where residents are fighting a heroin epidemic. Dr. Phil talks to teens., parents & meets with Mayor Bob Huber.
programme.sub-title: Heroin In Suburbia: A Town Intervention

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany wrote to Dr. Phil devastated to discover that her boyfriend, the man she loves & with whom she is having a baby, leads a double life. But Dr. Phil discovered that Brittany was leaving out important details. What his team uncovered is shocking!
programme.sub-title: Multiple Restraining Orders And Fake Births: What's Next? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with a family ripped apart by accusations of child molestation. Father Jason agrees to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Tune in to find out the results and what's next for this family!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Quinn says his wife, Sara, smashed a glass door, putting several stitches in his head, and punched, slapped, and kicked him in the face. But why won't he leave her? Can Dr. Phil help mend this fractured family as he confronts Sara about the alleged abuse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stacy and her boyfriend are accused of burning her 3-year-old daughter with cigarettes. What will lie detector tests reveal? Plus, Christina's mother has called CPS on her four times for allegedly abusing her grandson. Are Christina's kids in danger?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Michelle thought she had a perfect marriage until Wade admitted to keeping a horrible secret from his wife. Little did she know this one revelation would be the tip of the iceberg. Dr. Phil continues the startling story of Wade and Michelle. Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keith says his wife of 18 years, Sarah, is divorcing him and leaving their four children for "Kevin," a 26-year-old Kenyan pastor she met only on the internet. Dr. Phil sent a team to Kenya to investigate. You won’t want to miss what they discover!
programme.sub-title: My Wife Of 18 Years And Mother Of Our 4 Children Is Divorcing Me For A 26-Year-Old Kenyan Man She's Never Met

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christi says she was an Emmy-winning TV news reporter at the top of her career, but now her struggle with alcohol has left her jobless, homeless and estranged from her two adult daughters. Christi faces her girls for the first time in more than two years.
programme.sub-title: From Top TV Newcaster To Drunken Mom

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alisha says her son, Kevin, 10, pushed the family to the limit with violent outbursts. At home, knives and lighters are hidden & siblings lock themselves in their rooms at night. Alisha's says the 'future Kevin' may hurt the entire family or end a life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: An emotional intervention on Dr. Phil's stage: Siblings Sarah and PJ say for the past two years their mom, Kim, chose alcohol and pills over her four children. With father Pete headed to prison for mail fraud in a few weeks, the family is falling apart.
programme.sub-title: Time Is Running Out For Prison-Bound Dad: Did His Wife Blackmail Him Into Embezzling $300,000

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Don't miss Dr. Phil receiving his star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame! Plus, time is of the essence for mom Cindy. Daughter Cheyenne, 24, is a college student, Cindy's caretaker & sole financial supporter. Boyfriend, Blake, calls Cheyenne 'Cinderella'.
programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil Hollywood Walk Of Fame/My Mooching Mom Has 5 Months To Get A Life

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's interview with death row inmate Rodney Reed continues. Reed's attorney, Bryce Benjet tells what he thinks happened to Stacey. Retired NYPD detective Kevin Gannon & criminologist Dr. Lee Gilbertson say they know who killed Stacey & how.
programme.sub-title: What Happened To Stacey? What The Evidence Shows Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shaela went from being a mom to two with a master's degree working as a school counselor to being unemployed & living in an RV. Mom Sandra says Shaela has exhibited strange behaviors, including trimming bushes & pulling weeds in the middle of the night.
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Went From Being A School Counselor With A Master's Degree To Losing Her Children & Living In An RV

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kathi says son, Nico, 14, plays video games all day & charged thousands buying tokens. Nico attended only six days of school this year & when disciplined, Nico rages, curses & terrorizes. Kathi says he learned this behavior from his dad, Evo; Evo agrees.
programme.sub-title: Our Device Addicted Violent Teen Controls The House

programme.title: JAG

programme.title: JAG

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: With help from Harm, Mac, Harriet, and Bud, Admiral Chedwiggen investigates the apparent suicide of his mentor, Admiral Clancy, who allegedly shot himself while on a hunting trip. Harm and company ultimately uncover who the killer was.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Mac and Harm are assigned the task of defending a young Marine whose frustration at being unable to wrest custody of his son has led to his being court-martialed for dereliction of duty.

programme.title: JAG

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Harm is held captive by Palmer, a renegade government agent with whom he had crossed swords a few months ago. While Palmer prepares a life mask so he can pass for Harm, he explains his plans to assassinate the key witness in the trial.

programme.title: JAG

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
programme.desc: A six-year old boy suffers a life-threatening stroke; a man has a camp stove stuck on his penis; a young ER doctor is under the gun when he is asked to assess the health of another doctor's wife.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
programme.desc: While a shooting victim is brought to the hospital, a Rottweiler gets loose in the ER; a young mother's asthma attack turns quickly into a deadly heart failure; a young man comes into the ER comatose, covered with a mysterious rash.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
programme.desc: A bridesmaid drinks herself into a dangerous coma; a man's eyeball pops out of his head; a premature infant is left in a hospital toilet and must be quickly revived in the ER.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
programme.desc: An entire fraternity is plagued with blue urine; a pregnant woman may loose her baby to a spider bite; and a comatose patient turns out to be a drug runner who swallowed heroin.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
programme.desc: A pregnant woman can't get to the hospital in time, and must deliver in the front seat of her car. A bride can't go through with her wedding because she feels possessed by creatures crawling in her head.

programme.desc: A wheezing woman comes to the ER with a difficult-to-diagnose breathing problem, and a very angry husband! A grown man suddenly begins acting bizarrely like a child; is his medication helping him, or making him worse?!?
